tasks.goal: Create and verify bounded synthetic drill data
write_scope: Local database: rel_release_drill_round and rel_release_drill_step fixture batch REQ068 only
invariants: No application, schema, permission or account changes
Only release-owned round and step table inserts
interface_contracts: Current ReleaseOperationsStore joins and optional owners
non_goals: Create projects, plans, environments, issues, users
action_bounds: Write SQL and local runner in task directory
Assert IDs, names, tenant and references; serializable insert-only transaction
Use created_by=0 explicitly offline seed; no user impersonation or sys_audit writes
Run SQL then fresh readback and idempotency check
acceptance_checks: 6 new rounds/36 steps across two projects
evidence_required: Command exits and sanitized JSON result
tasks.rollback: Only unmodified/unreferenced exact batch IDs; never pre-existing records
stop_conditions: ID collision or duplicate round number

sampling_plan.label: postcommit
sampling_plan.observer: Fresh MySQL process; self-verification clearly identified
